name: The Berry Patch
description: The Berry Patch is an pumpkin patch in 781 Weaver Road, NC. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, best in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
